XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Vehicles fitted with special equipment:
    • SA5AS (Driving Assistant – Lane Departure Warning with active steering correction)

    • SA5AV (Active Guard – Forward Collision Warning with braking function)
  • System: ADAS

  • Device: Front side radar sensor

  • Fault: Sporadic and unjustified activation of the collision warning and Lane Departure Warning indicators

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: - -

  • Cause: The front side radar sensor requires calibration

• Action: Adjust the calibration of the front side radar sensor

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: - -
